```{r setup}
#| include: false

# Load packages
library(vitae)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(knitr)

# Detect output format
is_pdf <- knitr::is_latex_output()
is_html <- knitr::is_html_output()

# Load all data from Excel
excel_file <- here("jpbsCVdata", "cv_data_with_education.xlsx")

# Function to safely read Excel sheets
read_sheet_safe <- function(file, sheet_name) {
  tryCatch({
    read_excel(file, sheet = sheet_name)
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble() # Return empty tibble if sheet doesn't exist
  })
}

# Read Administrative data
admin <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "Administrative") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

# Read Education data
edu <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "Education") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  mutate(
    where = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", "),
    inst = institution,
    degree = degree,
    startYear = as.character(start_year),
    endYear = as.character(end_year),
    # Combine detail columns
    detail = case_when(
      !is.na(detail_1) & !is.na(detail_2) & !is.na(detail_3) ~ 
        paste(detail_1, detail_2, detail_3, sep = "; "),
      !is.na(detail_1) & !is.na(detail_2) ~ 
        paste(detail_1, detail_2, sep = "; "),
      !is.na(detail_1) ~ detail_1,
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# Read Certifications
certifications <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "Certifications") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  mutate(
    certBody = cert_body,
    accomplishment = accomplishment,
    year = as.character(year),
    where = if_else(is.na(where), "", where),
    detail = if_else(is.na(detail), "", detail)
  )

# Read Employment data
employment <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "Employment") %>%
  mutate(
    # Create sortable date for ordering
    start_sort = paste0(
      sub(".*-", "", if_else(is.na(start_date), "2000", start_date)),  # Year
      "-",
      case_when(
        grepl("January", start_date) ~ "01",
        grepl("February", start_date) ~ "02",
        grepl("March", start_date) ~ "03",
        grepl("April", start_date) ~ "04",
        grepl("May", start_date) ~ "05",
        grepl("June", start_date) ~ "06",
        grepl("July", start_date) ~ "07",
        grepl("August", start_date) ~ "08",
        grepl("September", start_date) ~ "09",
        grepl("October", start_date) ~ "10",
        grepl("November", start_date) ~ "11",
        grepl("December", start_date) ~ "12",
        TRUE ~ "00"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(current), desc(start_sort))

# Process Long-term employment
ltWork <- employment %>%
  filter(current == TRUE | 
         (!is.na(end_date) & end_date != "" & 
          as.numeric(sub(".*-", "", end_date)) >= 1997)) %>%
  mutate(
    institution = institution,
    detail = case_when(
      !is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" & 
      !is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" ~ 
        paste0(position_title, "\n• ", additional_titles, 
               "\n• COURSES TAUGHT — ", courses_taught),
      !is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" ~ 
        paste0(position_title, "\n• ", additional_titles),
      !is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" ~ 
        paste0(position_title, "\n• COURSES TAUGHT — ", courses_taught),
      TRUE ~ position_title
    ),
    startMonth = if_else(!is.na(start_date) & start_date != "", 
                        sub("-.*", "", start_date), ""),
    startYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date) & start_date != "", 
                       sub(".*-", "", start_date), ""),
    endMonth = case_when(
      is.na(end_date) | end_date == "" | current == TRUE ~ "Present",
      TRUE ~ sub("-.*", "", end_date)
    ),
    endYear = case_when(
      is.na(end_date) | end_date == "" | current == TRUE ~ "",
      TRUE ~ sub(".*-", "", end_date)
    ),
    where = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", ")
  )

# Process Short-term employment
stWork <- employment %>%
  filter(current == FALSE & 
         !is.na(end_date) & end_date != "" & 
         as.numeric(sub(".*-", "", end_date)) < 1997) %>%
  mutate(
    institution = institution,
    detail = case_when(
      !is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" & 
      !is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" ~ 
        paste0(position_title, "\n• ", additional_titles, 
               "\n• COURSES TAUGHT — ", courses_taught),
      !is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" ~ 
        paste0(position_title, "\n• ", additional_titles),
      !is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" ~ 
        paste0(position_title, "\n• COURSES TAUGHT — ", courses_taught),
      TRUE ~ position_title
    ),
    startMonth = if_else(!is.na(start_date) & start_date != "", 
                        sub("-.*", "", start_date), ""),
    startYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date) & start_date != "", 
                       sub(".*-", "", start_date), ""),
    endMonth = if_else(!is.na(end_date) & end_date != "", 
                      sub("-.*", "", end_date), ""),
    endYear = if_else(!is.na(end_date) & end_date != "", 
                     sub(".*-", "", end_date), ""),
    where = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", ")
  )

# Read Publications
publications <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "Publications") %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    articleTitle = title,
    authors = authors,
    journal = case_when(
      !is.na(volume) & !is.na(issue) & !is.na(pages) ~ 
        paste0(journal, ", v", volume, " n", issue, ", ", pages),
      !is.na(volume) & !is.na(pages) ~ 
        paste0(journal, ", v", volume, ", ", pages),
      !is.na(volume) ~ paste0(journal, ", v", volume),
      TRUE ~ journal
    ),
    year = as.character(year)
  )

# Read Honors and Grants
honorsGrants <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "Honors") %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    honorGrant = honor_grant,
    grantor = grantor,
    year = as.character(year),
    where = if_else(is.na(location), "", location),
    detail = if_else(is.na(notes), "", notes)
  )

# Read Working Papers
pip <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "WorkingPapers") %>%
  mutate(
    articleTitle = title,
    authors = authors,
    status = if_else(is.na(status), "", status)
  )

# Read Other Publications
otherPubsMonos <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "OtherPublications") %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    title = title,
    authors = authors,
    outlet = if_else(is.na(outlet), "", outlet),
    year = as.character(year)
  )

# Read Presentations
academicPresents <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "Presentations") %>%
  filter(type == "Paper" | type == "paper") %>%
  mutate(
    articleTitle = title,
    authors = if_else(is.na(authors), "", authors),
    detail = paste(conference, as.character(date), sep = ", ")
  )

pedagogyPresents <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "Presentations") %>%
  filter(type == "Pedagogy" | type == "pedagogy") %>%
  mutate(
    title = title,
    detail = paste(conference, as.character(date), sep = ", ")
  )

academicDiscussions <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "Presentations") %>%
  filter(type == "Discussion" | type == "discussion") %>%
  mutate(
    articleTitle = title,
    authors = if_else(is.na(authors), "", authors),
    detail = paste(conference, as.character(date), sep = ", ")
  )

# Read Service data
service_data <- read_sheet_safe(excel_file, "Service")

# Filter service data by category
editor <- service_data %>%
  filter(category == "Editor") %>%
  mutate(
    role = role,
    journal = organization,
    begYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub("-.*", "", as.character(start_date)), ""),
    endYear = if_else(is.na(end_date), "Present", sub("-.*", "", as.character(end_date)))
  )

adHocReview <- service_data %>%
  filter(category == "Reviewer") %>%
  mutate(
    outletName = organization,
    outletType = "Academic Journal"
  )

tAndP <- service_data %>%
  filter(category == "Tenure Review") %>%
  mutate(
    task = role,
    school = organization,
    year = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub("-.*", "", as.character(start_date)), ""),
    role = ""
  )

profesionalOFfices <- service_data %>%
  filter(category == "Professional Office") %>%
  mutate(
    title = role,
    group = organization,
    begYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub("-.*", "", as.character(start_date)), ""),
    endYear = if_else(is.na(end_date), "Present", sub("-.*", "", as.character(end_date)))
  )

academicLeader <- service_data %>%
  filter(category == "Leadership") %>%
  mutate(
    title = role,
    school = organization,
    begYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub("-.*", "", as.character(start_date)), ""),
    endYear = if_else(is.na(end_date), "Present", sub("-.*", "", as.character(end_date)))
  )

academicCommittees <- service_data %>%
  filter(category == "Committee") %>%
  mutate(
    committeeName = role,
    institution = organization,
    begYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date), sub("-.*", "", as.character(start_date)), ""),
    endYear = if_else(is.na(end_date), "Present", sub("-.*", "", as.character(end_date)))
  )
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if(is_pdf) {
  cat("# LONG-TERM ACADEMIC APPOINTMENTS\n\n")
}
```

```{r LTEMPLOYMENT, eval=is_pdf}
ltWork %>%
  detailed_entries(
    with = institution,
    why = detail,
    when = glue::glue("{startMonth} {startYear} --> {endMonth} {endYear}", .na = ""),
    where = where
  )
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if(is_html) {
  cat("## Long-Term Academic Appointments\n\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(ltWork)) {
    cat("<div class='appointment-entry'>\n")
    cat("<h4>", ltWork$institution[i], "</h4>\n")
    cat("<p class='location'>", ltWork$where[i], "</p>\n")
    cat("<p class='dates'>", ltWork$startMonth[i], " ", ltWork$startYear[i], 
        " → ", ltWork$endMonth[i], " ", ltWork$endYear[i], "</p>\n")
    cat("<p>", gsub("\n", "<br>", ltWork$detail[i]), "</p>\n")
    cat("</div>\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if(is_pdf) {
  cat("# SHORT-TERM ACADEMIC APPOINTMENTS\n\n")
}
```

```{r STEMPLOYMENT, eval=is_pdf}
stWork %>%
  detailed_entries(
    with = institution,
    why = detail,
    when = glue::glue("{startMonth} {startYear} --> {endMonth} {endYear}", .na = ""),
    where = where
  )
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if(is_html) {
  cat("## Short-Term Academic Appointments\n\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(stWork)) {
    cat("<div class='appointment-entry'>\n")
    cat("<h4>", stWork$institution[i], "</h4>\n")
    cat("<p class='location'>", stWork$where[i], "</p>\n")
    cat("<p class='dates'>", stWork$startMonth[i], " ", stWork$startYear[i],
        " → ", stWork$endMonth[i], " ", stWork$endYear[i], "</p>\n")
    cat("<p>", gsub("\n", "<br>", stWork$detail[i]), "</p>\n")
    cat("</div>\n\n")
  }
}
```
